newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's FHTK IPO 6.3 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's FHTK IPO 6.3 times subscribed.

text.p: Fruits and vegetables supplier FHTK Holdings Ltd said on Friday its initial public offering was 6.3 times subscribed.

The company had offered a total of 120.545 million shares at Singapore $0.60 cents each. The offer comprised a public tranche of 96.436 million shares, including 12.055 million shares reserved for staff and business associates.
The remaining 24.109 million shares were placed out.
Of the total, 29.173 million were vendor shares and 91.372 million new shares.
The offer raised net proceeds of about S$51.9 million from new shares and S$16.6 million from vendor shares.
The shares will trade on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore on a "when issued" basis on January 20.
